title: Settings
description: Your profile, sign-in security and — for admins — the people in this workspace.
impersonating: Security settings belong to the person you are signed in as. End the impersonation to manage your own account.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to your colleagues, and your language and time zone.
profile.name: Full name
profile.phoneInvalid: Use digits, spaces, brackets and dashes, optionally starting with +

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

email.title: Email address
email.description: You sign in with {email}. We'll send a confirmation link to the new address; the change applies once you open it.
email.sent: Check {email} for a confirmation link. It expires in 24 hours. Your current address stays active until then.
email.inUse: This email address is already in use.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in.
mfa.platformRequired: Required for platform accounts: it can't be turned off.
mfa.setupDescription: Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.disableDescription: Confirm with your password and a current code. Your recovery codes stop working.
mfa.disableWrong: The password or code is incorrect.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.description: Sign out a device you don't recognise, or everywhere at once.
sessions.revokeDescription: {device} will need to sign in again.
sessions.signOutAllDescription: Every device, including this one, will need to sign in again.
